findings.title: Temperature Rating Not Verified
findings.detail: Doors must have a fire resistance rating of at least 3 hours for heavy duty applications per CSA standards.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirming the temperature rating, we cannot ensure the door will perform in a fire.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 2.3 Performance Requirements/Standards .1 CSA for Heavy Duty.

findings.title: Grade Level Not Confirmed
findings.detail: Quoted values apply only to Grade 1 Cylindrical Locks. Confirm the submitted configuration.
findings.why_it_matters: Using the wrong grade could lead to premature wear or failure under heavy use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 2.3 Performance Requirements/Standards .2 All hardware to be Grade 1.

findings.title: Lock Cylinder Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Lock cylinders must be Abloy of Canada brand with no substitutions allowed.
findings.why_it_matters: Non-approved cylinders may not work with existing systems or compromise security.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .1 Lock Cylinders .1 Abloy of Canada Cylinders – no substitutions allowed.

findings.title: Hinge Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Hinges must be from approved brands: Stanley, Monthard, Hager, or McKinney.
findings.why_it_matters: Unapproved hinges might not support the door weight or meet durability needs.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .2 Hinges .1 Stanley/Monthard/Hager/McKinney.

findings.title: Pivot Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: If pivots are used, they must be from Dorma or Yale-Corbin (Rixson).
findings.why_it_matters: If pivots are used, the wrong brand could fail under stress or not match fire ratings.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .3 Pivots – (Only if needed as this is not UBC preferred hardware). .1 Dorma. .2 Yale - Corbin (Rixson).

findings.title: Door Stop Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Door stops, swing stops, and holders must be from approved brands: Rixson, Dorma, Hagar, Gallery, Ives, Glynn–Johnson, or Rockwood.
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect door stops may not hold the door properly or damage the frame over time.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .4 Door Stops, Swing Stops, and Holders .1 Rixson/Dorma/Hagar/Gallery/Ives/Glynn–Johnson/Rockwood.

findings.title: Flush Bolt Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Flush bolts must be from approved brands: Trimco, Ives, Glynn-Johnson, Gallery, or Rockwood.
findings.why_it_matters: Unapproved flush bolts might not secure the door leaf reliably during use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .5 Flush Bolts .1 Trimco/Ives/Glynn-Johnson/Gallery/Rockwood.

findings.title: Mortise Lock Series Not Verified
findings.detail: Mortise locks must be from specified series: Corbin ML2000, Schlage L9000, or Sargent 8200.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong mortise lock series may not fit the door prep or meet operational requirements.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .6 Mortise Locks and Trim .1 Corbin ML2000 series with LWA lever. .2 Schlage L9000 series with 03B lever. .3 Sargent 8200 series with LNJ lever.

findings.title: Cylindrical Lock Series Not Verified
findings.detail: Quoted values apply only to ND Series. Confirm the submitted configuration.
findings.why_it_matters: Using a different cylindrical lock series could mean it doesn’t meet the specified durability or security level.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .7 Cylindrical Locks .1 Corbin CL3300 series .2 Schlage ND series with Vandlguard .3 Sargent 10 line .4 LSDA-800 series Grade 2 levers.

findings.title: Push Button Code Lock Model Not Verified
findings.detail: Push button code locks must be Schlage CO 100 or Sargent KP series.
findings.why_it_matters: An unapproved code lock may not integrate with access control or withstand expected use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .8 Push Button Code Locks .1 Schlage CO 100 x less cylinder x KP x 626 .2 Sargent KP Series

findings.title: Alarm Lock Type Not Verified
findings.detail: Alarm locks must be Detex EAX500, Alarm Lock Pilfergard PG21 for stand-alone, or Sargent, Von Duprin, Corbin, Alarm Lock, Detex for panic bar style (must re-latch).
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong alarm locks might not trigger properly or fail to secure the door during an event.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .9 Alarm Locks .1 Stand-alone systems: Detex EAX500 or Alarm Lock Pilfergard PG21 .2 Panic Bar Style (must re-latch): Sargent, Von Duprin, Corbin, Alarm Lock, Detex

findings.title: Dead Bolt Type Not Verified
findings.detail: Dead bolt locks must be mortise (Corbin DL4000, Sargent 4800, Schlage L600) or cylindrical (ILCO 4514.25.1.04.04.5).
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect dead bolt type may not provide the required security or fail to latch properly.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .10 Dead Bolt Locks .1 Mortise: Corbin DL4000 series, Sargent 4800 series, Schlage L600 series. .2 Cylindrical: ILCO 4514.25.1.04.04.5

findings.title: Magnetic Lock Allowance Not Verified
findings.detail: Magnetic locks are not acceptable unless required by code; if used, must be Securitron M Series.
findings.why_it_matters: Using magnetic locks without code approval could create unsafe conditions or fail inspections.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .11 Magnetic Locks .1 Magnetic locks are not acceptable and should only be used when required by code. .2 Securitron M Series (if required)

findings.title: Exit Device Series Not Verified
findings.detail: Exit devices must be from specified series: Von Duprin 98XP, 99XP, 33A; Sargent 8000; or Corbin ED5000.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong exit devices may not release quickly in an emergency or fail to latch after use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .12 Exit Devices .1 Von Duprin 98XP and 99XP series, and 33A series. .2 Sargent 8000 series. .3 Corbin ED5000 series

findings.title: Door Closer Series Not Verified
findings.detail: Door closers must be LCN 4040XP, Sargent 351, Corbin 6200, or Norton 7700; floor closers are not acceptable.
findings.why_it_matters: Non-approved closers might not control the door speed, leading to damage or safety risks.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .13 Door Closers .1 LCN 4040XP Series x 689 finish. .2 Sargent 351 .3 Corbin 6200 / Norton 7700 .4 Floor closers are “not” acceptable at UBC.

findings.title: Power Operator Series Not Verified
findings.detail: Power operators and electrified closers must be LCN 4630/4640 Auto Equalizer, Record-8100, or Record-Simple Swing; no substitutions allowed.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong power operators could malfunction, fail to open/close properly, or not match accessibility needs.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .14 Power Operators and Electrified Closers .1 LCN 4630/4640 Series - "Auto Equalizer" x 689 finish. .2 Record-8100 Series and Record-Simple Swing units. .3 No substitutions allowed.

findings.title: Auto Opener Push Plate Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Automatic door opener push plates must be Camden or BEA, with 36" tall vertical actuation bar (high and low), hardwired with 'push to open' text.
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect push plates may not activate the operator reliably or meet accessibility standards.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .15 Automatic Door Opener Push Plates .1 Camden or BEA. .2 36" tall vertical actuation bar, high and low push plate. .3 Hardwired with 'push to open' text.

findings.title: Push Plate Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Push plates, pulls, and protective plates must be from Trimco, CBH, or Gallery.
findings.why_it_matters: Unapproved push plates or pulls might wear quickly, look mismatched, or fail under use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .16 Push Plates, Pulls and Protective Plates .1 Trimco/CBH/Gallery.

findings.title: Threshold Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Thresholds and weather-stripping must be from Pemko, Crowder, or Zero.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong thresholds may not seal properly, allowing drafts, water, or pests to enter.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .17 Thresholds and Weather-Stripping .1 Pemko/Crowder/Zero.

findings.title: Station Control Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Station controls and key switches must be from Von Duprin, LCN, RCI, Securitron, or Camden CM-1030-7224 SPDT with red & green LED.
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect station controls might not work with the security system or fail to operate as intended.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .18 Station Controls and Key Switches .1 Von Duprin/LCN/RCI/Securitron .2 Camden CM-1030-7224 SPDT with red & green LED

findings.title: Power Supply Battery Backup Not Verified
findings.detail: Power supplies must include battery backup and be from approved manufacturers: Locknetic/Folger-Adams, Securitron, Von Duprin, or Yale/Corbin.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing battery backup could cause doors to unlock or lock unexpectedly during power loss.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .19 Power Supplies .1 Use power supplies to match manufacturers’ equipment when required. .2 Power supplies require battery backup. .3 Locknetic/Folger-Adams, Securitron, Von Duprin, Yale/Corbin

findings.title: Electrified Strike Brand Not Verified
findings.detail: Electrified strikes must be from HES, RCI, or Adams Rite.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong strikes may not release when powered, trapping people inside or preventing entry.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .20 Electrified Strikes .1 HES/RCI/Adams Rite

findings.title: Transfer Hinge Wire Count Not Verified
findings.detail: Transfer hinges must be 12-wire standard from McKinney (with electro lynx), Stanley, or Hager.
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect wire count in transfer hinges could prevent proper signal transmission to the lock.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .21 Transfer Hinges –12 wire standard .1 McKinney with electro lynx, Stanley, Hager

findings.title: Hard-Wired Lockset Features Not Verified
findings.detail: Hard-wired electrified locksets must be from Schlage, Corbin, or Sargent and include integral magnetic position indicator, handle-integrated request to exit, and integrated I-Class compatible card/FOB reader.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing integrated features may reduce security, hinder exit monitoring, or block credential use.

compare.left_value: Hard-wired electrified locksets must be from Schlage, Corbin, or Sargent and include integral magnetic position indicator, handle-integrated request to exit, and integrated I-Class compatible card/FOB reader.

findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .22 Hard Wired Electrified Locksets .1 Manufacturers: Schlage, Corbin, Sargent [Manufacturers are currently under review] .2 Integral magnetic position indicator. .3 Handle integrated request to exit function .4 Integrated card / FOB reader (I-Class compatible)

findings.title: Wireless Lockset Battery Cycles Not Verified
findings.detail: Wireless electrified locksets must use non-proprietary battery supply only and provide a minimum of 50,000 cycles per battery supply.
findings.why_it_matters: Low cycle life means frequent battery changes, increasing maintenance and risk of failure.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .23 Wireless Electrified Locksets .1 [Manufacturers are currently under review] .2 Non-proprietary battery supply only .3 Minimum 50,000 cycles per battery supply .4 Hard-wired power source option preferred .5 Dedicated Wireless network hardware or encrypted Wi-Fi

findings.title: Electrified Exit Device Series Not Verified
findings.detail: Electrified exit devices must be from Corbin, Sargent, or Von Duprin QEL series, with electrified dogging required unless prohibited by code.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong electrified exit devices may not unlock during power failure or fail to re-latch after use.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .24 Electrified Exit Devices .1 Corbin/Sargent/Von Duprin (QEL series) .2 Electrified dogging required unless prohibited by code.

findings.title: Electrified Hold-Open Type Not Verified
findings.detail: Electrified hold-open devices must be Simplex RSG series or Edwards 1500 series; concealed hold-opens within door closers are not acceptable.
findings.why_it_matters: Unapproved hold-opens might not release during a fire, compromising smoke and flame containment.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .25 Electrified Hold-Open Devices .1 Simplex RSG series or Edwards 1500 series. .2 Install hold-open devices for fire separation doors in corridors and other high use areas where occupants will likely use door stops to hold the doors open, thereby compromising the fire rating of the opening. .3 Concealed hold-opens within door closers are not acceptable. .4 Coordinate location of surface-mounted hold-opens with the supplier to ensure sufficient wall and floor clearances are maintained.

findings.title: Lock Box Model Not Verified
findings.detail: Electrified lock boxes must be ProxSafe flex key management system.
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect lock boxes may not securely store keys or be accessible to emergency responders.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .26 Electrified Lock Boxes .1 ProxSafe flex key management system

findings.title: Card Strike FOB Reader Protocol Not Verified
findings.detail: Card strikes and FOB readers must be I-Class compatible.
findings.why_it_matters: Non I-Class compatible readers won’t work with the existing access control system.
findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .29 Card Strikes / FOB Readers .1 Supplied and installed by UBC Access and Security Services where not integrated into the lockset. .2 Contractor to supply and install pathway installation only as indicated on drawings. .3 I-Class compatible

findings.title: Fire Dept Lockbox Size Not Verified
findings.detail: Both quoted ratings are needed for this comparison.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong size lockbox may not fit fire department keys or cards, delaying emergency access.

compare.left_value: fire dept lockbox sleeve size = fire dept lockbox sleeve size options

findings.spec_ref: 08 71 00 3.1 Product Selection .1 Materials .30 Fire Department Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox .1 All new buildings to have a tube-shaped Fire Department lockbox installed close to the main entrance. The lockbox lid is to be installed flush with the exterior wall surface. .2 Lockboxes shall be cored into concrete, installed horizontally and epoxied into place. A free-standing externally-located square-faced concrete post can be used if there is no adequate location on the exterior wall surface. .3 Construction of key-deposit housing to be steel. .4 Cylinder housing to be hardened steel. .5 Sleeve size to be: 180 mm long x 63 mm diameter or 7 inches long x 2.5 inches diameter. .6 Manufacturer to be Abloy Key and Card Tube Deposit Lockbox – Abloy Protec.
